versions.changelog:
Initial release of "miniprogram-vibe-coding-starter" skill.

- Helps non-engineers use AI to design, build, and iterate WeChat mini-program MVPs from scratch.
- Provides step-by-step workflows: from clarifying ideas to launching and collecting feedback.
- Includes best practices, templates, and clear explanations tailored for product managers, creators, operators, and beginners.
- Focuses on practical mini-program development, avoiding unnecessary complexity.
- Features guides on state management, UI/UX, data modeling, sharing, compliance, and common pitfalls.
- Offers practical self-testing and deployment checklists, plus templates for interacting with development agents.
